note: WV DNR primitive campground in Chief Cornstalk Wildlife Management Area, 11,000 wooded acres south of Point Pleasant near Southside (Mason County), on a gravel road by a small pond. --Claude
summary: DNR's District 5 WMA page confirms 15 primitive campsites with vault toilets (agency-designated campsites, not a lot camping allowance; the DNR map marks a Campground), so ownership state stands. Not stated: hookups/water (derived 'none' left), fees, season, reservations, rig size. Note trimmed of the site count, toilets and no-water/no-hookup restatements.
